counting_convention.one_MAC: one multiply-accumulate in a dense or convolution contraction
counting_convention.headline_scope: Canonical network contractions, not redundant tiling work or all floating-point operations
excluded: Bias and residual additions; phase overlap/interleave additions; scalar multiplications/divisions and learned scaling.
Snake/sine, GELU/erf, PReLU, tanh, normalization/reductions and latent normalization.
Shape operations, padding/copies/transposes/reshapes, memory traffic, weight packing, allocation and dispatch.
These are canonical neural matrix/convolution MAC counts. They are not total CPU arithmetic or machine instructions.
AudioVAE2 StageStack redundant segment warmup and projection seed/replay overhead are excluded from the headline architecture count. These depend on segment count, duration and kernel implementation.
Convolutions count all stored taps, including conventional padded-boundary terms. Boundary kernels may skip some zero terms.
Both phase projection matrices count all unshifted columns, including their final previous column, although phase merging does not consume that last column.
No encoder computation, teacher computation, resampling, training or inference was run or counted.

hypothetical_48k_template.representation_warning: 24D at 93.75 Hz has 2250 scalar latent values/s versus AudioVAE2 64D at 25 Hz with 1600. This changes the latent clock and representation budget; it is not a latent-compatible replacement, a quality guarantee, or a coded-bitrate comparison.
